name: Get ecommerce onboarding status
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current onboarding status of the ecommerce integration for the account, including whether a store is connected and if the account is eligible for onboarding. Use the action that initiates onboarding when you need to start the onboarding process.

store_connected.description: True if a store is already connected to the account.

onboarding_eligible.description: True if the account meets all criteria to start ecommerce onboarding.

onboarding_ineligibility_reason.description: Reason why the account is not eligible for onboarding, if applicable.

onboarding.description: Detailed onboarding information if onboarding has been started; null otherwise.
